name: Kelvin Yuen
title: Data Manager
education: Information Management, Hong Kong City University (2011-2014)
bio: Data Nerd — I centralize data, turn it into insights, and tell a story worth remembering.
aboutLong: Senior Data Integration & Platform Leader with over 12 years of experience designing, scaling, and managing enterprise-level data platforms solutions in major banking and insurance institutions (Chubb Life, FWD, HSBC, ICBC, BOC). Proven track record of building high-performing data engineering teams from scratch, managing full lifecycle delivery (scope, cost, resource allocation), and handling critical cloud-based platform migrations and regulatory initiatives (such as IFRS17). Expert at bridging the gap between technical data engineering (Azure, Databricks) and business strategy, with deep competence in vendor management and SLA tracking.
